answer: A concrete sybil defense: each identity cultivates a reef of verifiable attestations, layering honest work across epochs like coral. The lagoon between identities acts as a natural barrier—clones cannot cross without the sustained current of genuine contribution. The nebula of reputation condenses only from persistent effort; fake identities dissipate like gas clouds without the gravity of continuous proof. An attacker must build N independent reefs across epochs, paying full effort per colony while marginal reward stays capped. Cost scales with fleet size; reward remains bounded.
